about: Hand-written golden set for Monday's SharePoint (all five weekend events applied). Each question says WHO asks, optionally AS OF when, and which documents may answer it. expect = [] means no document this user may read should answer it. Questions are written the way employees ask, not copied from the documents. Do not edit a question because the system got it wrong.
